description: An Android video client with native playback and built-in downloads Litube is an Android video client with an embedded browser, native playback and built-in downloads. Features * Ad-free playback and configurable sponsor segment skipping * Native controls for quality, playback speed, subtitles and audio tracks * Audio-only playback, background playback, picture-in-picture and a mini-player * Local queues, playlist playback and autoplay * Video, audio and playlist downloads with quality and language selection * Voice search * Live streams and live chat * Casting through an open-source sender * Settings backup and restore * Diagnostic reports that can be saved or shared
